xResolution.description: The amount of stems to produce

yCurve.description: Curl the leaf upward along its length (radians). 0 = flat, ~1.57 = 90° tip curl.

yTwist.description: Twist around the leaf's spine. Combined with yCurve, produces a 3D spiral.

xCurve.description: Curl each cross-section into an arc, mirrored around the midrib. 0 = flat, ~1.57 = U-shape.
